note: Evil Mode slice 14: the Scheme (design Part 22 sections 1 to 7; Part 5 section 7; Part 12 section 3 heists; Part 13 section 3 Digs; Part 26a section 2.4 Kanto's own scheme, the Ledger; Part 29 section 10.2 the screen; Part 30 section 3.6). Six Grand Schemes, one a Creed, each of four parts with a clean way and a dirty way (and a dearer second source when a part's lost). Groundwork's the last 20%, from the Creed's ordinary work. The percentage is never stored. Numbers are the design's starting values; none are playtested. A way marked limited is written down in docs/status/evil-mode-slice-14.md. "on": false is the slice's undo: the Scheme screen's hidden and nothing is stamped.

words.notReady: The Moment passes. {pct}%: under eighty. The Scheme stays where it is.
words.momentCame: The Moment's come: {name}. The team's ready. (The Finale is next: nothing happens yet.)
words.momentCaused: It's been caused. The Moment comes tomorrow morning.
words.groundCut: Groundwork {n}%: the Hero took a Badge where a Scheme job was running.
words.partLost: {part}: lost. It has a second source, dearer.
words.noScheme: No Scheme is written for this Creed.
words.inheritDone: {name} is the team's now. Four parts, every one stamped not clean.
words.inheritOther: Don't. It was never a good idea.
words.pick: Up and Down pick a row. Enter does it. Esc closes.

families.name: The Monopoly
families.says: Own the one thing everybody needs.
families.faint: A factory that hires the street, a port won on the best bid, a patent bought from the woman who wanted it used, and a calendar nobody's had to tear a page off early.

sentences.text: We're going to sell something.
We're going to make the thing everybody buys.
We're going to be the only ones who make it.
On the first of the month, everybody in the region pays us. Mr. Haskins wants to know what the price is.

ground.text: contracts: each racket made honest, each Front in profit with the back room shut

text.takes: ₽30,000 and three days: a factory, built, with a Books and a Hands to run it.
text.from: Nobody. The builders are paid. It hires forty locals at {town}.
text.gives: The Means, stamped clean. A factory.
text.hero: They'll walk past it. Somebody they know works there.

text.takes: Somebody else's factory, by a heist: ₽6,000 in costs.
text.from: Two hundred people on its floor. The Card names them: Mrs. Ilse Varga on the line, thirty-one years.
text.hero: Their aunt was on the floor that night.
text.written: Took a factory from the two hundred who worked in it.

second.name: Buy a share in someone else's

text.takes: ₽40,000: a share in someone else's factory.
text.from: The Haskins family, who'd rather not, and take the money.
text.gives: The Means, again. Dearer. Stamped clean.
text.written: Bought a share in a factory.

clean.name: Win its contract: the best bid

text.takes: ₽12,000 and two days: a Pay against two other bidders.
text.from: Two other bidders, who lose fairly.
text.gives: The Place, stamped clean. A port.
text.hero: Reads about it in the paper.
text.written: Won the port's contract with the best bid.

text.takes: A night in an office: the other bidder's papers, burned.
text.from: Ms. Petra Lindqvist, harbourmaster's clerk, who'd typed them for a week.
text.hero: Their friend's mother typed those papers.
text.written: Burned a rival's bid to win a port.

text.takes: ₽8,000: a smaller port. Takings −a fifth, for good.
text.from: Nobody much. It was for sale.
text.written: Bought a small port further off.

clean.name: Buy it from its inventor, fairly

text.takes: ₽10,000: the patent, bought.
text.from: Dr. Amara Osei, the inventor. She wants it used.
text.written: Bought a patent from its inventor, fairly.

text.takes: The patent, from her safe, by a heist.
text.from: Dr. Amara Osei. She wanted it used, not owned. Her mood goes to Shut.
text.hero: She's on their road. She tells them.
text.written: Took a patent from the woman who made it.

text.takes: A tenth of the takings, for ever.

moment.what: The day the old stock runs out

text.takes: Nothing. The old stock runs out when it runs out.
text.gives: The Moment, stamped clean, on its day.
text.written: Waited for the old stock to run out.

text.takes: A fire at a warehouse; a rumour. ₽2,000.
text.from: Somebody's shop's the one that runs out first: Mr. Tomas Rehn's, on the corner.
text.gives: The Moment, tomorrow, stamped not clean.
text.hero: Their mother's shop ran out first.
text.written: Set a fire so the old stock ran out early.

families.name: The Law
families.says: One rule of the world's changed. For everyone.
families.faint: A station that reports the team's own rackets too, an invitation to speak, a dull true file from an Archive, and a festival everyone was coming to anyway.

sentences.text: We've got a sentence on the door.
We're going to say it where people can hear.
We're going to make it true.
At the festival, the whole region's listening. Vera's checked the file twice.

clean.name: A station of your own: a Front

text.takes: ₽8,000 and two districts' patience: a radio mast, a Front. It's got to actually run.
text.from: Nobody. It reports the team's rackets too, if they're news.
text.written: Started a station that reports on the team too.

text.takes: Somebody's tower, for a night, by a heist.
text.from: The station's night crew. Archer did this. The Card says so.
text.hero: Was listening when it went off air.

text.takes: ₽1,500 and three days of printing. Slower: the Moment needs a week, not a day.
Regard 7, and a Leader who'll vouch (a Bent or Befriended Gym).
text.written: Was invited to speak in the square.

text.takes: Six squads, a day. Heat +4.
text.from: The square's market. The stallholders are named: Mrs. Ruth Abara, eggs; Mr. Ji-ho Park, knives.

text.takes: A day. The vote's local.
A Dig of papers: what the League knew and when.
text.from: Nobody. It's real, and it's dull, and it's enough.
text.hero: Reads it later and goes quiet.
text.written: Found the truth in an Archive.

text.takes: A forgery. Cheap, fast, vivid. ₽1,000.
text.from: Everyone who believes it. It's found out in the Finale, live.

text.takes: A person, who has to be asked, and may say no.
text.from: Mr. Abel Tanaka, a League clerk, retired.

text.takes: Nothing. It's on the calendar.
text.gives: The Moment, stamped clean, on its day.

text.takes: Something frightening, arranged, so people gather.
text.from: The whole town: a sentence on the door and a different one on the Ledger.
text.gives: The Moment, tomorrow, stamped not clean.

families.name: The Chair
families.faint: Four Leaders who'd vouch for the team, eight Badges earned in person, a tired Champion who says so, and a Cup the team simply enters.

sentences.text: We'd like a say.
The Gyms answer to us.
The League's going to answer to us.
At the Cup, it's the Boss in the bracket. Petra's ironed the jacket.

ground.text: every Gym dealt with, any way

text.takes: Four Gyms, dealt with by Bend, Replace or Befriend.
text.gives: The Means, stamped clean, the Evening the fourth is dealt with.
text.written: Four Gyms answer to the team, and agreed to.

text.takes: Four Gyms, with any one of them Bought or Beaten.
text.from: The Leaders who were bought or beaten.
text.gives: The Means, stamped not clean. They count. They're stamped.
text.hero: Fought a Leader who'd been bought.
text.written: Four Gyms answer to the team.

text.takes: A fifth Gym, dealt with any way.
text.gives: The Means, again, stamped by how.
text.written: A fifth Gym answers to the team.

text.takes: Eight Badges, earned like anyone: eight Gyms dealt with, in person.
text.from: Nobody. The Leaders know who they're fighting. Most fight harder.
text.hero: Hears the Boss is qualifying. Laughs. Then doesn't.

text.takes: A steward, paid. ₽15,000.
text.from: Mr. Desmond Achterberg, steward, who has a daughter at college.
text.hero: Was turned away at the same door.
text.written: Paid a steward for a way onto the Plateau.

text.takes: A year. An epilogue ending, not a Finale.

clean.name: One who's tired, and says so

text.takes: A Sit-Down with the Champion, at Regard 6.
text.from: Nobody. They're tired. They say so.
text.written: Sat down with a Champion who was tired.

dirty.name: One who's got something to hide

text.takes: An Expose, held back. Leverage: one proof the team holds.
text.from: The Champion, and whoever the secret's about.
text.hero: Senses something wrong with the Champion.
text.written: Held a Champion's secret over them.

text.takes: They'll open it, once, and leave.
text.written: A former Champion opened the door, once.

text.takes: Nothing but the bracket.
text.gives: The Moment, stamped clean, on its day.

text.takes: The Book racket, at scale: every match. ₽5,000.
text.gives: The Moment, tomorrow, stamped not clean.
text.hero: Loses a match they should've won.

families.name: The Waking
families.faint: A rite learned from the people who keep it, an invitation up the mountain, Signs earned one trial at a time, and an hour nobody forced.

sentences.text: We're looking for something old.
We know where it sleeps.
We're going to wake it.
We're going to wake it on Thursday. Chidi wants to know if you've decided what to say.

text.takes: Three days of being a guest: a shrine's keepers, an old couple on a mountain.
text.written: Learned the rite from the people who keep it.

text.takes: ₽25,000 and a Workshop. It hums. Then it doesn't.
text.from: The Specialist, who sends shorter notes.
text.written: Built a machine to call it.

text.takes: Whichever wasn't lost, again. ₽12,000.
text.written: Made the Means a second time.

text.takes: Asked up, by the keepers or the Leader whose district it is.
text.written: Went to the site as a guest.

text.takes: A Dig at the Legend's own site. The game stops and asks if you're sure.
text.written: Dug into a Legend's sleeping place.

text.takes: Every Legend has two. The weather's against the team there.
The Boss, in person: each Sign's trial.
text.hero: Did the same trial last year.
text.written: Earned the Signs, one trial at a time.

text.takes: A Sign, from where it's kept, by a heist. The Legend notices.
text.from: A shrine, and its keeper, Ms. Haruko Ishida.
text.written: Took a Sign from a shrine.

text.takes: A copy, at a Workshop. Clean, and the Legend knows a copy from the thing.
text.written: Made a copy of the Signs.

text.takes: Nothing. It comes.
text.gives: The Moment, stamped clean, on its day.

text.takes: A machine does this whether or not the Means was one. ₽3,000.
text.gives: The Moment, tomorrow, stamped not clean.

families.name: The Home
families.says: A town that's yours. On every map. For good.
families.faint: A charter that took all run, a place whose people said yes because they'd eaten in the Mess, a thousand names who came, and a door with nobody hiding behind it.

sentences.text: We'd like somewhere.
We're going to have somewhere.
It's going to be on the map.
When they come to take it back, we're going to stand in the door. Mrs. Adeyemi's baked.

text.takes: A form, a hearing in person, a signature. ₽2,000 in fees. It takes all run.
text.from: Nobody. The clerk's a local with a want.

text.takes: A day. ₽1,500. It'll hold till somebody checks.
Ten years. An epilogue.
Four or five people, asked. They say yes if they've eaten with the team: two locals at Warm.
text.written: Asked the people already there, and they said yes.

text.takes: A morning. Their things in the road.
text.from: The same people the team's made of: Mr. Kwame Boateng and his sister.
text.written: Cleared people out of the place nobody wanted.

text.takes: There's always another.
Every local at Warm, every Grunt who left with a handshake, everyone fed. The game's been counting since day 1.
text.gives: The Key, stamped clean, when the count reaches the need.
text.written: A thousand names, every one of them real.

text.takes: ₽5,000. A thousand names. None of them come.
text.hero: Looks for their name on it. It's there. They never signed.
text.written: Bought a list of a thousand names.

moment.what: When they try to take it back

text.takes: Nothing. The door's off.
text.gives: The Moment, stamped clean, on its day.

text.takes: Lock the door. Somebody has to put it back on.
text.gives: The Moment, tomorrow, stamped not clean.

families.name: The Fall
families.says: One person. Brought down. In public.
families.faint: Dull true proof, an invitation onto their stage, a person who came forward by themselves, and the same best day either way.

sentences.text: We remember what they did.
We can prove what they did.
Everyone's going to know what they did.
On their best day. Kofi asks if anyone else is on the Wall.

text.takes: A Dig of papers. It's dull and it's unanswerable.
A forgery. It's better than the truth: it's got the Target saying the thing aloud.
text.from: The Target, who didn't say it.

second.name: The Witness, alone, on a stage

text.takes: Their word.

clean.name: Wait to be invited onto it

text.takes: The Target invites the Boss. They think it's a reconciliation.
Squads at the doors.
A crate and a crowd.
They have to decide to. The Boss can ask once.
A Pay; a Lean. ₽4,000.
text.from: Their card's How it's written down: Made her betray him.

text.takes: It's the same either way: an award, a wedding, an opening.

ledger.name: The Ledger
ledger.says: Take Rocket's books. Every name in Kanto's in them. So's what each owes.

clean.name: A Sit-Down
clean.text: Giovanni mentions them himself: "I keep a small book."

dirty.name: Lux, at the Post
dirty.text: A tip, bought at the Post office. ₽500.

clean.name: Befriend a Rocket clerk
clean.text: A clerk who's never been thanked. A Persuade, four days.

dirty.name: Lean on the clerk
dirty.text: He tells you. He doesn't sleep that night.

clean.name: Ask him
clean.text: At Truce or better. "You want to read them? ...Sit there. Don't write anything down." An Evening in his office. Forty-three names.

dirty.name: A heist on the Game Corner's back office

clean.name: Forgive them
clean.text: Each name's a debt forgiven in the team's name. "You've cost me a great deal of money and made me look generous. I don't know which annoys me more."

dirty.name: Collect them
dirty.text: Each name's a debt collected: Funds, a great deal, and Dread +1.

in.name: Hands: a lock, a window, a duct
A false ticket, a uniform, an invitation

empty.in: No way in. You'll be going in by whatever's nearest.
empty.out: No way out. You'll be leaving by whatever's nearest.

rooms.name: The guard
rooms.text: A watchman with one Pokémon. A battle that mustn't be loud: win in three turns.

rooms.name: The dog
rooms.text: Somebody's partner. It's got a name on its bowl: Biscuit.

rooms.name: The floor
rooms.text: Boards; tiles; a beam of light. One of three's quiet.

rooms.name: The clerk
rooms.text: Somebody working late who shouldn't be there. Not a battle.

rooms.name: The other crew
rooms.text: The neighbour's, after the same thing.

thing.name: The thing
thing.text: The last room, and what's next to it: {beside}

list.name: The Museum
list.from: A curator who's guarded it thirty years
list.headline: MUSEUM ROBBED: CURATOR'S THIRTY YEARS GONE IN A NIGHT
list.beside: a photograph of the curator, younger, with the relic.
list.other: Ask. She's wanted someone to care about it for thirty years. A Persuade, three days: and the Key's clean.

list.name: The Liner
list.headline: LINER ROBBED AT SEA: 200 LOSE SAVINGS
list.beside: a list of whose deposits these are.
list.other: Buy a ticket. Win the tournament on B deck: ₽4,000.

list.name: The Lab
list.headline: LAB BREAK-IN: PROTOTYPE TAKEN
list.other: Fund it. ₽6,000. The Professor names it after the team, and is mortified later.

list.name: The Vault
list.headline: GANG FUNDS VANISH: POLICE SHRUG
list.other: A Truce. They pay to be left alone.

list.name: The Sign
list.takes: A Legend's Sign, from where it's kept
list.headline: SHRINE ROBBED
list.beside: the keeper's offering bowl, still warm.
list.other: Earn it. Each Sign has a trial. The Key's clean.

list.name: The Count Room
list.from: The neighbour, or a local with a licence
list.headline: GAME CORNER COUNT ROOM HIT
list.beside: the book, open, a column headed "Stock": forty-three.
list.other: Win it: at the tables, straight, in person. ₽2,500 on a good night.

list.name: The Freight
list.takes: A goods train between two towns
list.from: A company; and whatever's aboard for the Scheme
list.headline: MAGNET TRAIN FREIGHT STOPPED AND EMPTIED
list.beside: the driver's flask, and a photograph taped to the dial.
list.other: Bid for the haulage (a Front): the freight's the team's to carry.

list.name: The Auction
list.from: An auction house; a seller who needed the money
list.headline: AUCTION LOT STOLEN THE NIGHT BEFORE SALE
list.beside: the seller's letter: what the money was for.
list.other: Bid. In person. It costs what it's worth.

list.name: The Gala
list.takes: A room of jewels at a rich house, during a party
list.headline: GALA GUESTS ROBBED: EVERYONE SAW A FACE
list.beside: a dance card with the Boss's name on it.
list.other: Be invited. Regard 6+: the Boss goes as a guest.

list.name: The Evidence Room
list.takes: The team's own file, from the station
list.beside: the detective's own notes, in a careful hand.
list.other: A lawyer (₽6,000). Half the list's struck, properly.

list.name: The Purse
list.takes: A tournament's prize, before the final
list.from: A League; the finalist who'd have won it
list.headline: TOURNAMENT PURSE STOLEN BEFORE FINAL
list.other: Enter. Win. It's the prize, and applause.

list.name: The Ruin
list.found: Writing on a wall. It's a warning: "...not for taking. For keeping ...those who come after: leave it sleeping."

list.name: The Fossil Bed
list.found: A fossil, and whoever was there when it woke. It imprints on them.

list.name: The Sealed Door
list.found: It was sealed from the inside. There's a room. There's a chair. There's a ledger, in a hand a century older.

list.name: The Wreck
list.found: A ship's log. A name. Somebody in the district's descended. They'd like the log.

list.name: The Archive
list.found: It's about more people than the Target. One of them's on the Roster.

list.name: The Old Mine
list.found: The reason it was closed, in the foreman's last entry.

list.name: The Barrow
list.found: What's inside's somebody's. It's looked at, drawn, and left: or it isn't.

list.name: The Cistern
list.found: Somebody's living down there. They mend things people throw away.

list.name: The Seabed
list.found: A chamber with an air pocket and writing in dots. Somebody's been here and didn't touch it.

list.name: The Meteor
list.found: It hums. One Grunt's Pokémon won't go back in its ball for a day.

eyes: We're through the first chamber. There's carving, floor to ceiling. It's going to take longer than you want it to and I'd ask you to let it.
Second chamber. The carving changes. It's the same hand but faster. I think they were in a hurry.
hands: Got the door open. Hinges were bronze. Put them in a bag, labelled.
There's a second door. Sealed. Not locked: sealed. Different job.
doubts: We're in. I've been reading the wall. I'm not sure we should be reading the wall.
It says not to. I'm fairly sure now. It says it several ways.
It's open. I didn't open it. I watched.

after.doubts: No note. They're at the Office door at Night.
